confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Palermo pricing in peak July season; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by neighborhood and property. Cocktail and wine anchors use the usual Italian beer-to-drink relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. FX: the 0.6955 value is attributed to the RBA exchange-rates overview for 15 October 2026 based on search-result text; it was not confirmed against the RBA F11 table. A third-party page reports 0.6947 for 16 October 2026, but that was not verified on rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized southern Italian coastal cities with strong July tourism demand, such as Catania and Bari, adjusted for Palermo's generally lower restaurant and hotel prices than Rome, Florence, or Venice.
